objective: Theory spec of the secondary antiproton source term of theory:cr-secondary-antiprotons (pp, pHe, Hep, HeHe; antineutrons and hyperons) with an ILLUSTRATIVE toy cross section

model.description: secondary antiproton source term q(T) = sum_ij 4 pi n_j int phi_i dsigma_ij/dT dT_i for p and He projectiles on H and He gas, prompt antiprotons times the antineutron and hyperon factor; toy x-scaling pp cross section with constant channel rescaling

assumptions: steady, spatially uniform gas and primary fluxes (a local source term, before propagation)
projectiles p and He, targets H and He; heavier nuclei neglected
nuclear channels obtained from pp by constant factors at the same energy per nucleon (ILLUSTRATIVE)
antineutrons and hyperon feed-down as multiplicative factors on the prompt antiproton cross section
cross sections are inputs: a toy x-scaling form with ILLUSTRATIVE parameters, not a published parametrization
primary fluxes are inputs: ILLUSTRATIVE power laws in kinetic energy per nucleon

conventions.unit_system: CGS for the source term: q in cm^-3 s^-1 GeV^-1, gas densities in cm^-3, primary fluxes in cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 (GeV/n)^-1, cross sections in mb (1 mb = 1e-27 cm^2) and dsigma/dT in mb/GeV; energies in GeV [crpb:C06]
conventions.scales: reference energy T0 of the primary power laws (benchmark T0 = 1 GeV/n); production threshold T_th = (k_th - 1) m_p per nucleon with k_th = 7 [crpb:C02]
conventions.energy_variable: antiproton kinetic energy T_pbar in GeV; projectiles by kinetic energy per nucleon T_i in GeV/n
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest)
conventions.mass_approximation: proton mass m_p = 0.93827208816 GeV (CODATA 2018) for the threshold; nuclear binding and Fermi motion neglected [crpb:C06]
conventions.crpb:source_term: q_ij(T) = 4 pi n_j int_{T_th}^{oo} dT_i phi_i(T_i) dsigma_ij/dT(T_i, T), summed over projectiles i in {p, He} and targets j in {H, He} (channels pp, pHe, Hep, HeHe; projectile first) [crpb:C01]
conventions.crpb:ism: interstellar gas of hydrogen and helium only, n_He / n_H = 0.1; heavier targets and projectiles neglected [crpb:C02, crpb:C03]
conventions.crpb:antineutrons_hyperons: total = prompt antiprotons x (2 + Delta_IS + 2 Delta_Lambda) with both included, booked as (1 + Delta_Lambda) for antiprotons plus (1 + Delta_IS + Delta_Lambda) for antineutrons; Delta_Lambda = c_Lambda (Lambda-bar / pbar); each part can be excluded and the choice is stated [crpb:C04, crpb:C05]
conventions.crpb:cross_sections: input sets under models/ (xs-toy-*.json): an ILLUSTRATIVE toy x-scaling prompt pp cross section, constant ILLUSTRATIVE channel rescaling factors, Delta_IS and Lambda-bar/pbar; not a published parametrization; a choice between sets is a model-alternative uncertainty object, never a Gaussian per bin [crpb:C05]; the published pp closed forms in models/xs-dimauro2014-pp.json serve the external benchmark only [crpb:C08]
conventions.crpb:bin_average: a binned value is the total source term averaged linearly in T_pbar over the bin, (1/Delta T) int q dT (Gauss-Legendre, 8 nodes per piece, split at T_th)

extension.order: not-applicable (source integral over a parametrized cross section, no perturbative expansion)

scales.meaning: reference energy per nucleon of the primary power laws

validity_domain.physics: the toy cross section is a placeholder: the result tests the source-integral machinery and its bookkeeping, it is not a physical antiproton source term

checks_run.name: substitution x = T/T_i maps the source integral to an incomplete beta function (SymPy)
above threshold: beta function B(gamma, n + 1) for symbolic gamma, n = 0, 1, 2, 3, 7 (SymPy)
below threshold: incomplete beta B(T/T_th; gamma, n + 1), n = 2 (SymPy)
antineutron and hyperon bookkeeping equals 2 + Delta_IS + 2 Delta_Lambda (SymPy)
numerical quadrature vs closed form, four channels, power-law and broken power-law primaries, energies on both sides of the threshold
units and dimensions (q in cm^-3 s^-1 GeV^-1)

checks_not_run: comparison with published source-term values (open question B2: which table or figure, and whether digitizing a figure is acceptable)
any published cross-section parametrization (none is reproduced; the toy sets are ILLUSTRATIVE)
propagation of the source term and comparison with measured antiproton fluxes
degenerate-direction analysis: not applicable, model.family is a source term, not cosmic-ray-propagation, so contracts/validate.py does not require degenerate_directions
neglected: energy dependence of the channel rescaling
projectiles and targets heavier than helium
energy dependence of Delta_IS and Lambda-bar/pbar
kinematic dependence of the threshold on T_pbar
